defect.summary: gstack-motion-capture created frames/ before checking the page's capture contract and refused any --out with frames/ but no capture.json, so after MOTION_CONTRACT_MISSING or a crash the rerun into the same --out was refused. Its font and image wait could also hang on offscreen lazy images.

answer_key_audit.notes: Confirmed: the fix says the capture.json test is replaced 'so the rerun after MOTION_CONTRACT_MISSING or a crash works'. At the reviewed head lines 82-85 refused any --out holding frames/ without capture.json, and line 88 created frames/ before the contract check that exits with MOTION_CONTRACT_MISSING, so every rerun after that error was refused. The same commit bounds the font and image wait at lines 64-67, which hung on offscreen lazy images ('bounded at 30 s instead of hanging'), and adds a 'retry after a refused page' test. Needs human check: severity (no rating or failing test is named for this defect.); decoy (078fb60583da extends the manifest validator this decoy added (fps/windowFrames >= 1, window fits the frames); whether that fixes a defect in the decoy's validator was not read before the token cap.).
